home.title: Soccer predictions built on probabilities, not hunches
paragraphs: IASHARK's statistical model estimates each team's chances from match data: results, goals, form and home or away performance. For MLS, the Premier League (EPL), Liga MX, the Champions League and the other competitions we cover, it estimates the probability of each result, the number of goals and both teams to score. Bookmaker odds, with their margin removed, are used to compare against those estimates and to choose among the markets actually on offer.

These are statistical estimates: soccer is uncertain, no outcome is guaranteed and IASHARK is not a bookmaker. Data coverage varies by league, so every analysis shows its data-quality rating. 18+ only (21+ where required by state law).
